Logging and auditing coverage: Site creation, deletion, restart, shutdown, archive, suspension and ownership changes.
Additional execution / operational evide: Collect through Purview or Office 365 Management Activity API. Correlate administrative events with site status and availability monitoring.

What it represents: Controls over public/private exposure and permitted client networks
Example instance: Private finance portal; corporate IP allowlist
Logging and auditing coverage: Visibility and visibility-permission changes; IP ranges added or removed.
Additional execution / operational evide: Validate resulting access with authenticated and anonymous tests; an audit event alone does not establish effective exposure.

What it represents: The public hostname and TLS certificate attached to a site
Logging and auditing coverage: Custom domain connection/removal and certificate updates.
Additional execution / operational evide: Supplement with DNS change records and TLS/expiry checks from the services operating those controls.

What it represents: Settings controlling site behaviour and identity integration
Primary audit source: Conditional Dataverse auditing; source control / deployment history
Logging and auditing coverage: Audit supported backing records only after confirming table and column audit capability; preserve configuration versions.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enhanced-model component tables include virtual representations; do not assume standard-model auditing carries over. Sign-in outcomes require identity-provider evidence.

What it represents: A page and its content within the site
Primary audit source: Conditional Dataverse auditing; source control / deployment history
Logging and auditing coverage: Where supported and enabled, record changes to underlying page configuration.
Additional execution / operational evide: Page views require separate traffic telemetry. Use deployment diffs when the backing configuration is not auditable.

Resource type / scope: Web template / content snippet / web file
What it represents: Reusable rendering logic, text, scripts, styles and site assets
Primary audit source: Conditional Dataverse auditing; source control / deployment history
Logging and auditing coverage: Conditional change auditing of supported backing records; use versioned content to establish exact changes.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enhanced data model stores components differently; verify audit support before marking covered. Asset access requires separate telemetry.

What it represents: Components that present or collect Dataverse records
Primary audit source: Conditional Dataverse auditing; source control / deployment history
Logging and auditing coverage: Configuration-change coverage depends on auditable backing tables; submitted business records need their own auditing.
Additional execution / operational evide: Custom interaction telemetry can record form steps; correlate submission results with the resulting business record and server errors.

Resource type / scope: Web role / page permission / table permission
What it represents: Site access rules controlling pages and business data
Primary audit source: Conditional Dataverse auditing; source control / deployment history
Logging and auditing coverage: Validate audit support for permission records and associations; retain before/after configuration evidence.
Additional execution / operational evide: Run authorization tests. Enhanced authorization is a separate preview capability; it must not be inferred from use of the enhanced data model.

What it represents: A visitor's site identity and its external-provider association
Primary audit source: Dataverse auditing where supported; identity-provider logs
Logging and auditing coverage: Audit enabled contact and supported identity records; authentication evidence comes from the configured provider.
Additional execution / operational evide: Contacts represent site users. Do not assume every backend audit actor identifies the visitor; verify actual attribution.

What it represents: Dataverse records read or changed through the portal
Logging and auditing coverage: Enable environment, table and column auditing for supported record changes; retrieve history through Web API/SDK.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enhanced authorization (preview) documents site-user attribution when enabled. Otherwise verify the recorded actor and add application correlation where needed.

What it represents: Reads and data operations performed through site pages and API endpoints
Primary audit source: Dataverse activity logging where applicable; site/request telemetry
Logging and auditing coverage: Ordinary Dataverse change auditing does not capture reads/exports. Validate activity-logging support and identity attribution for the actual portal path.
Additional execution / operational evide: A page view is not proof of a specific record read. Audit writes on business tables; use additional request instrumentation for endpoint-level evidence.

What it represents: Request filtering and protection of the website
Primary audit source: Power Pages WAF logs; Purview for enable/disable
Logging and auditing coverage: WAF logs provide traffic evidence including client/socket IP and request URI; Purview records WAF enablement changes.
Additional execution / operational evide: Enable WAF and download logs through the supported Power Pages interface. Do not assume its managed Front Door is a customer-owned Azure diagnostic-settings resource.

What it represents: Application error records generated by the website
Primary audit source: Power Pages diagnostic logs → Azure Blob Storage
Logging and auditing coverage: Enable website diagnostics with an owned Blob Storage connection and retention policy; Purview records diagnostic logging toggles.
Additional execution / operational evide: Collect error files from Blob Storage. These are application-error logs, not a complete HTTP access trail. Re-enable diagnostics after changing the connected Dataverse instance.

Primary audit source: Application Insights or another configured analytics provider
Logging and auditing coverage: Add tracking HTML/JavaScript through the Tracking Code snippet; collected events depend on the chosen provider and instrumentation.
Additional execution / operational evide: Client telemetry can be blocked, sampled or absent and is not an authoritative audit trail. Custom events require explicit instrumentation.

What it represents: Site connections to document and reporting services
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview — Power Pages; downstream workload logs
Additional execution / operational evide: Collect document/report access separately from the downstream workload; enabling an integration does not establish access-log coverage.

What it represents: Service authentication material and content delivery configuration
Logging and auditing coverage: Website authentication-key updates and CDN enablement/disablement.
Additional execution / operational evide: Check service health and configuration after changes; these events are not per-request delivery logs.

What it represents: Governance of the Power Platform environment hosting the site
Primary audit source: Microsoft Purview — Power Platform admin activity
Logging and auditing coverage: Supported environment lifecycle, settings and data-policy operations; admin activity collection is enabled by default.
Additional execution / operational evide: Collect through Purview/API and correlate environment changes with affected sites and dependencies.

What it represents: Promotion of site content and configuration between environments
Logging and auditing coverage: Retain commits, approvals, deployment identity and results; enhanced-model site components participate in solution-based ALM.
Additional execution / operational evide: Treat as complementary evidence, not guaranteed Dataverse field-level audit coverage; map deployed version to site and environment.
